newText: no corresponding section found in the 1913 Act
_about: For each section of the Companies Ordinance, 1984, the section of the Indian Companies Act, 1913 (the law in force before the Ordinance) that appears to deal with the same matter. This is not a published table: each pair was found by comparing the headings and wording of the two texts (an automatic match, in the order of the two laws), so every pair is a lead to be confirmed. "Probable" pairs have a weaker match. A dash means no matching section was found: the Ordinance section may be new, or the match was too weak to show. The text of the 1913 Act is itself incomplete in places (see its note).
note: 534 sections of the Ordinance; 260 have a matching section of the 1913 Act (218 close matches, 42 probable). Matched automatically by heading and wording, not from a published table.
